swimming_pool.evidence: The only pool, a round blue above-ground pool, is at the top edge of the tile on a neighboring lot, not the central lot. No water surface is visible on the central lot.

detached_structure.evidence: A small gray rectangular roofed section at the right of the central house, near (370,305), may be an attached carport or a small shed. It is hard to tell whether it is separate.

signals.notes: The central house has a brown, shaded, mottled roof with visible staining and is partly covered by heavy tree canopy on the east and south sides. The lawn to the west is dry and patchy, and the round above-ground pool at the top belongs to a neighboring lot.
